reasons.title: Low RSRP
reasons.description: Serving cell RSRP is far below the poor threshold, indicating the UE is at the edge of coverage or shadowed. Downstream SINR/CQI/MCS degradation is a symptom of this weak signal, not an independent interference problem.

solutions.title: Uptilt / re-point nearest sector toward the affected area
solutions.description: Adjust the serving sector's mechanical or electrical downtilt to improve coverage in the affected drive-test segment, based on the geolocation of the low-RSRP samples.

solutions.title: Evaluate a new small-cell / repeater site
solutions.description: If antenna re-pointing does not sufficiently close the coverage gap, evaluate adding a small cell or repeater to serve this specific area.
